newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina hopes to restart Balongan unit next week.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina hopes to restart Balongan unit next week.

text.p: Indonesian state oil company Pertamina hopes to restart the residue catalytic cracker (RCC) unit at its Balongan refinery next week, industry sources said on Monday.
"Pertamina hopes to restart the RCC unit next week. Work on the unit is still going on," one source said without giving an exact date for the restart.
The sources said Balongan's 125,000-barrel per day (bpd) capacity crude distillation unit (CDU) remained shut and would be restarted along with the RCC.
The RCC has been closed since February 6 due to an unexpected technical problem and the CDU was last shut on March 3 when the refinery residue fuel tanks were full.
Pertamina junior processing director Samto Utomo said on February 25 that attempts to restart the RCC on February 20 failed because of what he described only as "another small problem."
He said it would take three weeks to repair the RCC.
